findings.summary: Goal version activation remains unwired into the production composition path: build_line constructs GoalRequestKernel with an empty active_version and no production code calls activate_version, so the version-bound approve/reject guard compares against an empty version until a live Goal/version event arrives. The kernel's explicit-version and stale-version-refusal semantics are implemented and offline-tested; wiring a content_revision->activate_version source is deferred integration consistent with the spec's 'full MCP enroll/repo lifecycle' later slice, not a development-stage violation. Unchanged by this attempt's two fixes.
